policies.description: Any member of a tenant may view that tenant's orders.
policies.content: permit(principal, action == Action::"viewOrder", resource) when { principal.tenant == resource.tenant };

policies.description: Support agents may refund orders of their own tenant up to 500.
policies.content: permit(principal in Role::"support", action == Action::"refundOrder", resource) when { principal.tenant == resource.tenant && resource.amount <= 500 };

policies.description: Support agents may view customer profiles of their own tenant.
policies.content: permit(principal in Role::"support", action == Action::"viewCustomer", resource) when { principal.tenant == resource.tenant };

policies.description: Finance staff may read their tenant's ledger.
policies.content: permit(principal in Role::"finance", action == Action::"viewLedger", resource) when { principal.tenant == resource.tenant };

policies.description: Exporting the ledger additionally requires a fresh MFA assertion in the request context.
policies.content: permit(principal in Role::"finance", action == Action::"exportLedger", resource) when { principal.tenant == resource.tenant && context.mfa == true };

policies.description: Tenant administrators may perform any action on their own tenant's resources.
policies.content: permit(principal in Role::"admin", action, resource) when { principal.tenant == resource.tenant };

policies.description: Hard tenant isolation: no principal may touch another tenant's resources.
policies.content: forbid(principal, action, resource) unless { principal.tenant == resource.tenant };

policies.description: Suspended principals are denied everything, regardless of role.
Customer deletion is only possible inside an approved change window.
policies.content: forbid(principal, action == Action::"deleteCustomer", resource) unless { context has changeWindow && context.changeWindow == true };
